title: Cuckold Counseling Confessions
description:
Hello, I’m Dr. Granger- but you can call me Emma…

I understand you’ve been having some relationship problems, and are looking for some guidance, and to cope with the pain and confusion of catching your girlfriend cheating on you. To help get to the root of this issue, I need you to answer some very deeply personal questions, and follow all my instructions. 

You will have no problem telling me the truth. Oh, and I’ll need a few pictures of you, for your file. I promise my female colleagues are professional and won’t laugh THAT much.
author: Shadow
